name: DENC3ICFConceptMap
title: DEN.C3 ConceptMap to ICF
description: Candidate terminology mappings for DEN.C3 local concepts to ICF. Mappings are inexact/narrower and require terminology review; unsupported concepts are explicitly unmapped.

text.div:
Mappings are candidate relationships from the source data dictionary and secondary mapping workbook. They are not independently terminology-validated. Inexact and narrower relations intentionally avoid claiming exact equivalence.

  • hypotensive-shock: Every relevant source row is marked not classifiable in ICF; no ICF target is asserted.
  • severe-bleeding: Every relevant source row is marked not classifiable in ICF; no ICF target is asserted.
